mapper.select: SELECT c.id_key,c.workspace_snapshot,m.title AS current_title,m.active FROM arte_ai_conversation_new c LEFT JOIN arte_ai_conversation_metadata m ON c.id_key=m.id_key AND c.owner_key=m.owner_key WHERE c.owner_key=#{owner} AND c.id_key IN #{key}
SELECT workspace_snapshot FROM arte_ai_invocation WHERE owner_key=#{owner} AND id_key IN #{key}
SELECT workspace_snapshot FROM arte_ai_turn WHERE conversation_key=#{conversation} AND id_key=#{key}
